notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Just updating this game to let everybody know that this VN has been updated, and is now playable in Russian!

I also fixed a handful of typos in the English version, so if anybody owns this VN but hasn't played it yet, now would be a good time! ☆彡

tags.bug: - Fixed a handful of typos in the English version.

notes.title: New build
notes.content:
Hi guys,

I just uploaded a new build for this VN! It has a few differences from the previous version, including:

- two improved backgrounds
- new, cleaner SFX (particularly for the ambient sounds, like the chirping birds and the car engine)
- transitions between sprite pose changes
- some minor grammatical tweaks

If anybody happens to find any spelling errors, or any other issues in the build, you can leave it in the reply to this post and I will try to fix up any problems ASAP.

- ebi x
